basis: Microvascular thrombosis causes hemolysis and thrombocytopenia; direct renal microangiopathic injury occurs in well over 30% across the major syndromes.
Toxic injury to the optic nerve causes visual loss; an inflammatory parent does not establish an immune mechanism.
EBV-associated B-cell lymphoproliferation characteristically destroys pulmonary tissue; reported skin and CNS frequencies vary around the 30% threshold.
Pulmonary valve stenosis, atrial septal defect and electrocardiographic abnormalities define a cardiac syndrome.
Familial isolated dilated cardiomyopathy directly affects cardiac muscle.
GI polyposis and alopecia, pigmentation and nail dystrophy define the syndrome; anemia is generally secondary to enteric disease or nutritional loss.
Cobalamin metabolic defect; intellectual disability and developmental delay occur in 30-79%. Renal insufficiency is 5-29%; hepatomegaly alone does not establish liver damage.
The umbrella is defined by cardiac disease together with skin or hair abnormalities.
The uterine cervix is a reproductive organ outside the specified axes; infection is not intrinsic to this umbrella.
Defined by dysfunction of neural synapses, including the neuromuscular junction.
WHIM is defined by warts, hypogammaglobulinemia, infections and myelokathexis with neutropenia.
The tumor originates in a major salivary gland, which belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Microcephaly, severe intellectual disability, spasticity and structural eye disease define the syndrome; hypogonadism is reported in 80-99%.
A midbrain syndrome causing ipsilateral oculomotor nerve palsy and contralateral weakness; the ocular motor deficit originates in neural injury.
Candida infection directly affects the oral mucosa.
Site-unspecified extragonadal tumor umbrella, commonly mediastinal or retroperitoneal; no covered organ is intrinsic across the group. CNS and GI origins require site-specific labels.
Histoplasma infection directly inflames the meninges.
Persistent familial blood eosinophilia; pulmonary infiltrates are reported in 30-79%, supporting direct pulmonary involvement. Cardiac infiltration lacks a reliable frequency.
Intrinsic neutrophil granule and bactericidal defects cause immunodeficiency; recurrent pneumonia and otitis are separately diagnosed infections.
Congenital digit shortening and syndactyly constitute a skeletal developmental disorder.
A thymic epithelial carcinoma; the thymus is outside the listed anatomical axes, and epithelial malignancy alone does not establish an immune or blood-cell disease.
Intestinal fluke infection directly occupies the bowel; ectopic organ infection is occasional.
Lacrimal aplasia, dental/salivary defects and thumb abnormalities define the syndrome; external ear malformations occur in approximately 50-57%.
Malignant tumor arising from hepatocytes; associated hepatitis and cirrhosis are separate diseases, and pulmonary metastasis is not intrinsic to most cases.
An eating disorder characterized by recurrent regurgitation; the supplied concept does not establish intrinsic gastrointestinal tissue injury.
